metadata.value: exploit the synergy between images and 3D point clouds by learning to select the most relevant views for each point; uses the viewing conditions of 3D points to merge features from images taken at arbitrary positions
metadata.normalized_value: exploit the synergy between images and 3D point clouds by learning to select the most relevant views for each point; uses the viewing conditions of 3D points to merge features from images taken at arbitrary positions
metadata.evidence:
We propose to exploit the synergy between **images** 🖼️ and **3D point clouds** 
☁️ by learning to select the most relevant views for each point. Our approach 
uses the **viewing conditions** 👀 of 3D points to merge features from images 
taken at **arbitrary positions**.
metadata.reason: Describes the core method used by the artifact

metadata.value: S3DIS (74.7 mIoU 6-Fold) and on KITTI- 360 (58.3 mIoU)
metadata.evidence:
We reach SOTA results for S3DIS (74.7 mIoU 
6-Fold) and on KITTI- 360 (58.3 mIoU) without requiring point colorization, 
meshing, or the use of depth cameras
